sources: Fisher, Brown, Aron, Strong & Mashek (2010). Reward, addiction, and emotion regulation systems associated with rejection in love. Journal of Neurophysiology 104(1). 15 recently rejected, still in love; ex's photo vs neutral: VTA, nucleus accumbens/orbitofrontal (craving/addiction, cocaine-like dopaminergic system), insula/anterior cingulate (pain); attachment-related ventral putamen/pallidum activity decreased with time since rejection. Via ScienceDaily 2010.
